purpose: Lock the smallest paid benchmark and commercial thresholds that can produce decision-grade evidence immediately after signer approval, without spending or enabling checkout now.

controlled_paid_benchmark_plan.locked_request_class: request-equivalent structured web search with five returned results where supported
controlled_paid_benchmark_plan.retry_reserve_rule: Allow at most one paid retry per failed trial; abort on any quote above policy or task budget.
controlled_paid_benchmark_plan.hard_policy: Actual signed quotes and settled spend are authoritative. No payment occurs until signer C01-C12 passes and controlled funding is permitted. Existing A$25 transaction and A$40 daily limits remain hard ceilings.

commercial_thresholds.first_revenue_target: One externally verified A$49 payment only after APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT.
commercial_thresholds.first_customer_success: Approved workload delivered through request-to-evidence flow and accepted under deterministic criteria.
commercial_thresholds.repeat_signal: Customer supplies or purchases a second workload after successful first delivery.
commercial_thresholds.early_validation_target: At least 3 paid customers and at least 1 repeat workload before expanding task classes or adding material spend.
commercial_thresholds.kill_or_reposition_trigger: If qualified prospects with recurring paid search workloads do not value cross-provider effective-cost evidence, or if competitors provide request-equivalent paid outcome economics with comparable deterministic evidence at negligible switching cost, escalate for founder go/no-go rather than broaden ideation autonomously.

launch_controls.no_secret_rule: No private keys, seed phrases, wallet secrets or scoped credentials may be requested or recorded in model-visible artifacts.

truthfulness: This is a prepared benchmark/commercial plan, not paid benchmark evidence, signer evidence, customer traction, revenue or Relay approval.
